senses.zh_definition: 所指尚待上下文确定的专名形式；例如 Merida 是动画电影《勇敢传说》中的公主名。不能据此认定小写 merida 是具有固定释义的马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved proper-name form; Merida, for example, names the princess in Brave. No Malay common-noun meaning is established by the supplied evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk nama khas yang rujukannya belum dapat dipastikan tanpa konteks; misalnya, Merida ialah nama puteri dalam filem Brave. Takrif ini ialah penjelasan editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有释义、读音或原始用例，因此不能标为 official，也不能指定唯一词源或读音。以下组合与情境明确选用《勇敢传说》角色这一已核实的所指，仅作教学示例，不表示已确定原始语料所指或核验其搭配频率。角色资料见 [Pixar：Brave](https://www.pixar.com/brave)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 这篇影评探讨了梅莉达公主与母亲之间的关系。
dual_scenarios.en: The film review discusses the relationship between Princess Merida and her mother.

etymology.historical_story: A name encountered in Malay writing need not be a Malay vocabulary item. Pixar identifies Merida as the princess at the centre of Brave, providing one documented cultural reference for this spelling. That identification does not establish the name's linguistic origin or the intended reference in this packet. Its etymology therefore remains unresolved. [Source: Pixar](https://www.pixar.com/brave).
